parsed.note_claim: The videos and incident are from the January 2 2024 runway collision at Tokyo Haneda Airport.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On 2 January 2024, a runway collision occurred at Haneda Airport in Tokyo, Japan, involving an Airbus A350, operating as Japan Airlines Flight 516, and a De Havilland Canada Dash 8 operated by the Japan Coast Guard (JA722A).
parsed.reason: The Wikipedia page directly confirms the date, location, and nature of the incident as described in the note.
